name: Warrior of Mercy

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A masked healer and executioner whose touch can mend wounds or inflict them.

feature.name: Hand of Harm
feature.summary: Once per turn when an Unarmed Strike hits, spend 1 Focus to add a Martial Arts die + Wisdom Necrotic damage.
feature.text: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can spend 1 Focus Point to deal extra Necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.

feature.name: Hand of Healing
feature.summary: Magic action, 1 Focus: a creature you touch regains a Martial Arts die + Wisdom Hit Points; it can replace a Flurry of Blows strike.
feature.text: As a Magic action you can spend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature and restore Hit Points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier. When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of its Unarmed Strikes with this healing without spending a Focus Point for it.

feature.name: Implements of Mercy
feature.summary: Proficiency in Insight and Medicine and with the Herbalism Kit.
feature.text: You gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills and with the Herbalism Kit.

feature.name: Physician's Touch
feature.summary: Hand of Harm can also poison; Hand of Healing can also end Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned.
feature.text: Hand of Harm: when you use it on a creature, you can also give it the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn. Hand of Healing: when you use it, you can also end one of these conditions on the creature: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned.

feature.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
feature.summary: Replace each Flurry of Blows strike with Hand of Healing for free; add Hand of Harm to Flurry hits without Focus, Wisdom-modifier times per Long Rest.
feature.text: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can swap each Unarmed Strike for a use of Hand of Healing that costs no Focus Point. And when an Unarmed Strike from Flurry of Blows deals damage, you can add Hand of Harm to it without spending a Focus Point (still only once per turn). You can use these free benefits a total number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining every use on a Long Rest.

feature.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
feature.summary: Once per Long Rest, spend 5 Focus Points to return a creature that died within the past 24 hours to life.
